True Summer vs True Winter

True Summer and True Winter are neighbouring colour seasons. They share the same undertone. The difference is depth: True Summer is light-medium, True Winter is medium-deep; contrast: True Summer is medium-low, True Winter is high; chroma: True Summer is soft-medium, True Winter is clear.

Questions

What is the difference between True Summer and True Winter?

True Summer and True Winter are neighbouring colour seasons. They share the same undertone. The difference is depth: True Summer is light-medium, True Winter is medium-deep; contrast: True Summer is medium-low, True Winter is high; chroma: True Summer is soft-medium, True Winter is clear.

Can I be between True Summer and True Winter?

Yes. Neighbouring seasons share a lot, and many people sit near the border. That's why Season Card shows your closest season and a runner-up.

How do I tell if I'm True Summer or True Winter?

Focus on depth and contrast and chroma. In daylight, compare a colour from each palette under your chin, for example rose pink (True Summer) and silver grey (True Winter), and see which makes your skin look more even.
